shop.name: Walkie-talkie
shop.desc: Hold Q to transmit. Everyone holding one hears you. So might something else.

shop.name: Crowbar
shop.desc: LMB to swing. Frees a grabbed teammate, pries jammed doors. Loud.

shop.name: Bottles x3
shop.desc: LMB to throw. A 15 m crash the Hound cannot resist.

shop.name: Glowsticks x5
shop.desc: Drop to mark a path. Keeps a Mannequin lit.

shop.name: Medkit
shop.desc: Revive a teammate where they fell, within 30 s. Single use.

shop.name: Pro Flashlight
shop.desc: Tier II LED beam: brighter, wider, twice the battery. Works from any slot. Also keeps a Mannequin lit from further away.

shop.name: Flares x3
shop.desc: LMB to throw. Burns bright red for 60 s: lights the room, keeps a Mannequin lit. Hisses softly.

shop.name: Motion sensors x2
shop.desc: LMB to place. The van console shows anything that moves within 6 m of it, even what you can't see. E picks it back up.
